items.claim: Disclosure  — `Disclosure` ignored `<Disabled>` scopes and took no `disabledReason`
items.note: I made a call here and wrote it in `docs/unruled.md`: a `<ReadOnly>` scope does not stop it, because folding a section changes no value.

items.claim: EasingPicker  — "Convert to bezier" turned 21 of the 31 named curves into CSS `ease`
items.note: Quart, quint, expo, circ, and back now convert to their own standard control points. Elastic and bounce get no Convert button, since no single cubic draws them.

items.claim: FillStrokeSwatch  — its chips ignored `<Disabled>`/`<ReadOnly>` scopes, so shift-click still toggled a paint to none, and it took no hold props
items.note: My call, also in `docs/unruled.md`: read-only chips still pick the target slot but don't open the editor; disabled chips pick nothing.

items.claim: EffectCard  — its name field and Duplicate/Remove buttons stayed focusable "to tell" a reason but never told it
EffectList CSS (B; A noted it too) — held Duplicate/Remove buttons kept the pointer cursor and hover color
items.note: in the same commit as the reason fix.

items.claim: EasingPicker read-only  — the Convert button had no read-only mark
items.note: This adds a `changes` option to `useNativeHold`, which marks a button that makes a change as disabled while read-only.

items.claim: FitScope spent mark  — the scope kept `data-fit-spent` after its labels changed to ones that fit
items.note: The label-change path and the font-load path now reset the room through one shared helper (`forgetRoom`).

items.claim: `--fit-natural` under a scaled ancestor  — the width was measured in transformed px on one branch and layout px on the other
Font loads  — the scale stage listened to the global `document.fonts` instead of the scope's own document
FloatingPanel  — an uncontrolled panel ignored a changed `anchor` before its first drag
useHoldReason  — the tooltip stayed bound to a replaced element while the reason was unchanged
